rules.auxiliary: Separate a licensed connective plus attached auxiliary.
rules.boundary.attached: Recover an ending consonant fused into the final syllable.
rules.boundary.eu: Select the (으) allomorph according to the stem boundary.
rules.boundary.regular: Remove an ending with no stem spelling change.
rules.contraction.vowel: Undo vowel contraction (와, 워, 돼, or 여).
rules.contraction.yeo_absorption: Recover 어 absorbed after an open ㅕ stem (켜, 펴); retain the separate ㅣ + 어 contraction reading.
rules.copula: Separate a nominal and the affirmative copula 이다.
rules.copula.omitted_ending: Restore omitted copular 이 after a vowel-final nominal before a reviewed ending; the nominal is not a conjugated verb stem.
rules.copula.zero: Restore the omitted copula after a vowel-final nominal.
rules.deletion.rieul: Restore ㄹ lost before a consonant ending.
rules.ending.result_connective: Recover -아/어/여다(가) at a bare verb boundary, preserving the short and full forms and reviewed following auxiliaries; sentence-level transfer and object constraints are not inferred.
rules.identity: Unchanged vocabulary hypothesis; no dictionary verification.
rules.irregular.digeut: Hypothesize ㄷ irregular class: ㄷ becomes ㄹ before a vowel.
rules.irregular.ha: Restore 하 from 해 or 하여.
rules.irregular.hieut: Hypothesize ㅎ irregular class: deletion or vowel contraction.
rules.irregular.siot: Hypothesize ㅅ irregular class: ㅅ disappears before a vowel.
rules.particle: Remove a particle with licensed order and boundary allomorph.
rules.particle.contraction.n: Expand attached ㄴ to topic/emphatic 는 after an open syllable.
rules.particle.enumerative_da: Attach enumerative 다/이다 to a nominal in an equal-footing list; the surrounding enumeration is not inferred from this token.
